caption: One composter a slice, as many slices side by side as there are crops to compost: the line of hoppers along the top carries the farm's mixed output; each slice's filter hopper holds its crop (41 of it and four named papers), so it takes only that crop from the line, and a comparator reading it unlocks the hopper under it for a moment whenever one more arrives. That hopper, kept full of the crop, drops one into the composter each time; the hopper under the composter pulls the bone meal out into the slice's chest. Anything no slice takes runs on to the overflow chest at the end of the line. A block on each line hopper keeps strays out (the input chest stands on the first).
